title: App browsing sequence

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Let expressive welcome content lead into efficient browsing so personality supports the customer’s task.
strategic_value: The illustrated greeting can introduce Sweetgreen’s voice before consistent cards organize food choices.
demonstration: A phone on a kale background moves from a personalized home screen into warm bowls, salads, sides and beverages.
practical_value: Compare the emphasis of a welcoming hero with the repeated structure needed for product browsing.

content_islands.name: Home screen
content_islands.spec: Begin with greeting, bowl illustration, featured food and ordering control.

content_islands.name: Menu screens
content_islands.spec: Continue through categorized food cards with product photography, descriptions and actions.

content_islands.name: Kale surround
content_islands.spec: Keep the dense kale photograph fixed around the phone.

reference_purposes.Application: The complete clip displays multiple stages of mobile food browsing.
reference_purposes.Expression: The illustrative greeting gives way to consistently styled food cards.
